<p>Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, prior to the installation of the replacement roof, full specification details of the roof, including material colour, size, material (excluding the rooflights) and samples of the materials, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and once installed shall be retained and maintained in full.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, prior to their installation full specification details of all of the proposed conservation rooflights shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and once installed shall be retained and maintained in full.&nbsp;</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The new window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p>Notwithstanding the window details shown on the approved plans, prior to the installation of any windows (excluding rooflights), full specification details of the windows, including their proposed colour, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and once installed shall be retained and maintained in full.</p>
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room retaining garage door; installation of window in side elevation of garage; loft conversion to create habitable roof space; rooflights in rear roof slope and roof crown;  installation and replacement of roof (like for like); external alterations
